categories.main_business_segments: Great Wall Motor Company Limited primarily engages in the design, research and development, manufacturing, sales, and service of automobiles and automotive parts. Its product portfolio includes SUVs, sedans, pickup trucks, MPVs, and motorcycles, covering traditional internal combustion engines and new energy vehicles. The company operates multiple brands such as Haval, Tank, Wey, Ora, and Great Wall Pickup, focusing on intelligent and new energy vehicles as well as global market expansion.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes intelligent and new energy vehicle technologies, including self-developed intelligent cockpit platforms (Coffee OS 3), advanced intelligent driving systems (Coffee Pilot Ultra), and proprietary RISC-V automotive-grade MCU chips (Zijing M100). It has developed a comprehensive hybrid technology system (Hi4 family) with multiple architectures for different off-road capabilities. Great Wall also invests in diverse battery chemistries (ternary, lithium iron phosphate, sodium, solid-state) and high-power fast charging platforms, alongside hydrogen fuel cell technology with integrated industry chain capabilities.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Great Wall serves a broad customer base including individual consumers and commercial users domestically in China and internationally. Its products target various market segments such as urban commuters, off-road enthusiasts, and high-end new energy vehicle buyers. The company’s overseas markets span over 170 countries and regions, with a strong presence in Southeast Asia, Latin America, Africa, and Europe, catering to diverse consumer needs with differentiated product offerings.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations are primarily based in China, with manufacturing and R&D facilities across multiple Chinese cities including Baoding, Beijing, Shanghai, Tianjin, and Chongqing. Internationally, Great Wall has established production bases in Thailand, Brazil, and KD assembly plants in Ecuador, Pakistan, Malaysia, and Vietnam. Its sales network covers over 170 countries and regions worldwide, with significant growth in overseas sales contributing to its global footprint.
categories.supply_chain_position: Great Wall operates as an integrated automotive manufacturer with upstream, midstream, and downstream capabilities. It develops and produces core components such as powertrains, chassis, intelligent cockpit hardware and software, and energy systems internally. The company also collaborates with over 500 ecosystem partners in AI, chip design, and connected vehicle technologies, ensuring supply chain stability and cost efficiency while maintaining vertical integration in key technologies.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities focus on intelligent new energy vehicles, off-road technology advancement, and global expansion under the 'ONE GWM' brand initiative. R&D efforts emphasize intelligent driving, AI-powered cockpit systems, hybrid and electric powertrain innovation, and hydrogen fuel cell development. Great Wall invests heavily in building end-to-end intelligent driving models, AI data intelligence systems, and supercomputing centers to maintain technological leadership and accelerate product innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Great Wall generates revenue primarily through the sale of complete vehicles and automotive parts. It also earns income from providing automotive-related services and manufacturing molds. The company benefits from government subsidies related to new energy vehicles. Additionally, it invests in financial products and manages cash assets to optimize returns, but the core revenue remains product sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Great Wall positions itself as a leading Chinese automotive brand with a strong focus on SUVs, pickup trucks, and new energy vehicles. It competes with domestic and international automakers in the intelligent and new energy vehicle segments. The company is recognized as a global SUV expert and a pioneer in off-road and hybrid technologies, holding a significant market share in China and expanding rapidly overseas.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Great Wall achieved total revenue of approximately RMB 202.2 billion, representing a 16.73% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders reached RMB 12.69 billion, an 80.76% increase from the previous year. The company sold 1.23 million vehicles globally, with overseas sales growing 44.61%. It maintains a strong balance sheet with total assets exceeding RMB 217 billion and continues to invest heavily in R&D, with expenditures surpassing RMB 10 billion annually.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Great Wall emphasizes high-quality manufacturing, intelligent technology integration, and diversified product offerings tailored to various customer needs. Its unique value lies in pioneering intelligent driving systems, advanced hybrid architectures, and comprehensive new energy solutions including hydrogen fuel cells. The company’s multi-brand strategy caters to different market segments, from affordable SUVs to luxury electric vehicles and off-road specialists, delivering superior user experience, safety, and performance.
